1 year ago, @POTUS & Democrats passed the #AmericanRescuePlan & delivered:
 
—Critical survival checks
—Expanded Child Tax Credit
—Billions for vaccine distribution
—Housing & nutrition assistance
—$$ for schools & childcare
—& more
 
Our work to support our communities continues

Building a new community health center at Randolph High School will improve the physical wellness of our young people and their readiness to learn.
 
Proud to deliver $1M in federal funding to do just that. https://t.co/BfxUs78m06

This #MayDay and every day, I stand in solidarity with workers everywhere organizing for better wages, fair treatment, and a safe workplace.

Organized power is realized power✊🏿

Our #LongHaulers in Massachusetts and beyond have been ignored for too long and they need our support.
 
My #TREATLongCovid Act would change that by helping folks with #LongCOVID get treatment that is accessible and within their reach. 
https://t.co/wPP9wICjhi

@USDA's child nutrition waivers have helped feed millions of kids during the pandemic.
 
@RepMcGovern, @RepBarbaraLee & I are urging action to extend these waivers so our children can continue accessing free, healthy school meals. https://t.co/3MucuAACd0

It's been nearly impossible for families in Massachusetts to find baby formula, especially for those on WIC.

That's why @RepLoriTrahan, @RepKClark & I want answers from Abbott Nutrition on their plans to restock Similac baby formula in the Commonwealth.
https://t.co/ZjL9AsZoVo

The recently-recalled Similac baby formula is the exclusive brand for MA families on WIC—making it nearly impossible for them to find formula.

We need @AbbottNews to explain when parents in the Commonwealth can expect to see Similac on store shelves.
https://t.co/BS8F4FYxy9

🚨This week, the House passed a budget bill with many of our key priorities on housing, nutrition, climate, and more.

Our communities need bold investments that meet the moment, and I won't stop fighting to deliver for them. 

Here are a few that we secured:🧵

By failing to invest in meaningful treatment, research and data collection, we are failing a community of #LongHaulers who need immediate support.

It’s time to pass my bill to #TREATLongCOVID & help millions across the nation.
https://t.co/jwSiKtFC3r

American policy towards Haiti must be rooted in fair treatment, justice, and partnership. 

We must urgently fill the Special Envoy vacancy.
https://t.co/7skyOb8hWd

Tune in now as I join Dimock Center leadership, patients, and staff in celebrating the $1M in federal funding we secured to support substance use treatment and programming at the community health center. https://t.co/uhc8IjtwN4

I was so proud to deliver $1M for @TheDimockCenter.

These funds will help launch Boston's first-ever men’s clinical stabilization program, which will help patients detox while accessing health & recovery services right on campus. https://t.co/jSXxBUl2En

The $1M in federal funding we delivered for @TheDimockCenter will be transformative and help more men battling addiction achieve sobriety and forge their own success stories.

Investments directly in our people always yield the greatest return. https://t.co/6qVExGMUe6

Community Project Funding Victory:

This year, we secured $1,000,000 for @TheDimockCenter to support their substance use treatment & programming.

These funds will help launch the first-ever men’s clinical stabilization program in Boston! https://t.co/9a93kfGYQN

Community Project Funding Victory:

This year, we secured $1,000,000 to build a new community health center at Randolph High School.

This center will help us address healthcare shortages in Randolph and improve the physical wellness of Randolph residents and students. https://t.co/9UMxb9MeOx

With COVID emergency declarations ending, we must ensure folks with #LongCOVID aren't left behind in our recovery.

I'm proud to re-introduce the #TREATLongCOVID Act with @RepDonBeyer & @RepLBR to help #LongHaulers get the treatment & care they deserve.
https://t.co/FrnA2cNtO0

Many servicemembers suffer from traction alopecia due to the military’s strict grooming standards.

@RepBonnie, @RepMcClellan & I are introducing a bill to add traction alopecia & wigs as a covered medical treatment under TRICARE, the healthcare program for servicemembers.

In 1968, Dr. King taught us to remain awake during a great revolution.

In 2023, there are forces at work that want to lull us to sleep with their fear mongering & hate.

TY @MarchOnFest & @WNCathedral for inviting me to discuss King's legacy & how we can remain awake today. https://t.co/UDBb5rpP79

Expand trauma supports for servicemembers suffering from #PTSD, Traumatic Brain Injury, & Military Sexual Trauma, including treatment for:

—substance abuse
—depression
—& related disorders

Everyone deserves the resources they need to heal & thrive.

This is great news. #LongCOVID is a growing crisis, and I'm glad @HHSGov is taking more steps to address it.
 
I'll keep fighting to make sure our #LongHaulers get the funding, research, & treatment they deserve.

Greg Abbott's treatment of migrant families at the border is cruel, inhumane, and unacceptable.

Immigrant rights are human rights and there must be accountability.

Today we celebrate our veterans, who give so much for our country but often without realizing the full freedom, just treatment & equality they deserve.

On #VeteransDay, let's honor them by ending forever wars & passing policies that affirm their dignity, humanity & wellbeing.

Elections must be free, fair, & without fear of violence or intimidation.

The U.S. must stand with the Pakistani people as they exercise their right to vote, & we must never support the subversion of democracy in Pakistan or elsewhere.

TY @BostonChildrens for giving me the privilege to meet Molly & the Flynn family.

I remain undeterred in protecting & expanding Medicaid to remove barriers to treatment & services, & address gaps in coverage.

Because our children & families deserve access to the care they need. https://t.co/0mdHzMHryI

Our seniors deserve to age with dignity & remain connected to their community.

That's why I'm grateful for the Cambridge Senior Center's rec classes, tech support, meals & other services that improve our elders' lives.

It was a joy to volunteer & join for a quick exercise. https://t.co/GITP8Lhqfq
